proof_0049.moves: In a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected space the clopen sets form a basis for the topology; since U is open and contains x, U is a neighbourhood of x, and the basis characterization of neighbourhoods hands back a clopen V with x in V and V contained in U.

proof_0050.moves: A product indexed by the subtype of a set is reindexed as a product over the corresponding finset, using prod_subtype with the membership compatibility x in s.toFinset iff x in s; the result is then flipped with symm.

proof_0051.moves: Pure specialization: the general statement about comparing the minimum key of a modified tree map under an arbitrary comparator is instantiated at the Ord instance's compare. No mathematical step beyond the instantiation.

proof_0052.moves: The monoidal comparison map delta for the free-module functor is by construction the inverse of the mu isomorphism, so the value on a generator is read off from the corresponding lemma about that inverse. A one-step delegation.

proof_0053.moves: Set.piecewise is just an if-then-else on membership in s, so the continuity criterion for if-then-else applies verbatim: the two branches are continuous and agree on the frontier of s.

proof_0054.moves: Take n in the support of p; membership in the support forces n at most natDegree p, and natDegree p is below m by hypothesis, so n < m by transitivity, which is exactly membership in range m. The proof is a pointwise subset introduction plus one chain of inequalities.

proof_0055.moves: ofList is by definition repeated insertion into the empty map, so containment in the built map reduces to the internal lemma about insertMany from empty, which says a key is present exactly when it occurs among the keys of the list. The comparator/BEq compatibility class is what lets the list-side BEq test match the tree-side comparison.

proof_0056.moves: ContinuousWithinAt is by definition a Tendsto statement along the within-neighbourhood filter, so the theorem is the filter-limit version of nsmul applied directly to the hypothesis. Nothing beyond unfolding the definition.

proof_0057.moves: An auto-generated simp lemma for the inverse of the linear equivalence obtained by post-composing locally constant functions with e: both sides are the same term after unfolding, so the proof is rfl. There is no mathematical step at all.

proof_0058.moves: The non-dependent tree map is a thin wrapper around the dependent one, so getElem equals get of getElem? is inherited verbatim from the dependent Const-version lemma. Pure unwrapping.

proof_0059.moves: Exhibit the explicit basis 1, i, j, k indexed by Fin 4 for the quaternion algebra over R, and conclude module-finiteness from the general fact that a module with a basis indexed by a finite type is finite.

proof_0060.moves: Definitional: the strict-inequality position predicate on a string slice is set up so that it literally reduces to the non-strict one at the relevant raw position, so the proof is rfl. No mathematical content, only unfolding.

proof_0061.moves: The coercion from the reals into an RCLike field is the algebra map, and ring homomorphisms send minus r to minus its image; the theorem is that general coercion lemma specialized here.

proof_0062.moves: For the model space with the trivial model-with-corners, the chart at any point is the identity partial equivalence, and composing it with the identity model leaves it unchanged; the extended chart therefore collapses to PartialEquiv.refl. Discharged by simp, so most of the term is normalization residue.

proof_0063.moves: Rewrite the goal f = g along the already-established extensionality characterization, which turns equality into an existential over the source equality, target equality and the compatibility of the isomorphisms; then supply exactly the three hypotheses as witnesses. The real content is exhibiting witnesses, not any cited theorem beyond ext_iff.

proof_0064.moves: To say an isometry equivalence preserves Hausdorff measure one checks two things: the map is measurable, which follows because it is continuous and the space carries the Borel sigma-algebra, and the pushforward of the Hausdorff measure is itself, which is the substantive input.

proof_0065.moves: Equality of the two derivative functions is proved pointwise: fix a point, apply the pointwise fact that adding a constant does not change the derivative, then bundle back up with funext.

proof_0066.moves: Conditional independence of families of sets is defined as independence with respect to the conditional expectation kernel, so the union criterion is literally the kernel-level union criterion. A definitional transfer.

proof_0067.moves: Start from the known identity cosh squared equals sinh squared plus one and swap the two summands by commutativity of addition; the proof is a two-link chain of equalities.

proof_0068.moves: The function constantly equal to one is a constant function, so pointwise its derivative is zero by the constant rule; funext turns the pointwise statement into equality of functions. The only real recognition is that 1 as a function means the constant function.

proof_0069.moves: For real-valued integrands the absolute value is the norm, so the statement is exactly the already-proved norm version of the identity relating the oriented interval integral to the integral over the unordered interval.

proof_0070.moves: To show a scalar multiple of a left-invariant measure is still left invariant, check the defining condition: push forward c times mu under left translation, use that pushforward commutes with scaling the measure, then use the invariance of mu itself. The rest of the term is rewriting residue.

proof_0071.moves: An auto-generated simp lemma stating that the monoid homomorphism packaging the dilation ratio evaluates to the ratio; true by definition, proved by rfl. No mathematical step.

proof_0072.moves: A simply connected set means the subtype carries a SimplyConnectedSpace structure, which in particular gives a PathConnectedSpace structure on the subtype; converting that back into the set-level statement is the characterization of IsPathConnected via path-connectedness of the coerced subtype.
